text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер hasn't shown up for training.

Worried, I go looking for her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Gaaah! I know it happens every time,
but I can't
wait for that catchphrase!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: You know it, Natie! That's the best part of The C-Team.
text_block_list.name: Appliance Store Owner

text_block_list.text:
I find Найс Нэйчер intently watching a
show on a
display TV at the appliance
store.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh! There's the van! Here it comes! Is he
gonna
take out his ciga—
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Wha—Trainer! What are you doing here?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list:
...I pity the fool who's not wearing their
tracksuit!

text_block_list.text:
Haha, that sounds like something they
would say
in the show. But why are you
talking about
track...suits...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: R-roger that! I'll do better from now on...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I love it when a plan comes together!
...Next time,
hopefully.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
